verdict.rationale: QuickBooks' first-party A/R page says users can run an A/R aging report showing which customers are late on payments. It also says QuickBooks tracks invoices and payments, identifies delinquent accounts, and can send statement reminders to late-paying customers. Together these cover the core accounts-receivable tracking story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-customer balance views (implied by customer-level aging and statements but never stated), detail on aging report configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
